name: screen-clip
description: Windows instant-replay screen clipper with audio
author: Screen Clip

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently "npm run watch:main" "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5175 && electron . --vite"
scripts.dist: node -e "process.env.FORCE_FFMPEG_WIN='1';require('child_process').execSync('node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.js',{stdio:'inherit',env:process.env})" && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.pack:dir: node -e "process.env.FORCE_FFMPEG_WIN='1';require('child_process').execSync('node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.js',{stdio:'inherit',env:process.env})" && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.pack:zip: node -e "process.env.FORCE_FFMPEG_WIN='1';require('child_process').execSync('node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.js',{stdio:'inherit',env:process.env})" && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win zip
